query.text: 请帮我看下站台边上的人，有危险或状态变化时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please help me keep an eye on the people near the edge of the platform, and alert me if there is any danger or change in their situation.

annotation.text_zh: 列车正在进站，请立即退到安全线以内。
annotation.text_en: The train is arriving, please step behind the safety line immediately.

annotation.text_zh: 车门已经打开，请注意安全上车。
annotation.text_en: The doors are open, please watch your step as you get on.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
